4118/24, 9:21 AM Minnesota Senate

Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge Thomas
J Christenson

Judge Thomas J. Christenson gave testimony on his resume, and role at the court.

Member discussion.
Senator Marty moved that Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge Thomas
J Christenson, be recommended for confirmation. - MOTION ADOPTED.

Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge
Kathryn H Carlson

Judge Kathryn H. Carlson gave testimony on her resume, and role at the court.

Member discussion.

Member discussion on the Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals as a whole.

Judge Quinn returned to answer member questions.

Senator John Marty moved to recommend Chief Judge Patricia Mullen, Judge Deborah Sundquist, Judge Sean Quinn, Judge Thomas

Christenson, and Judge Kathryn Carlson for confirmation to the Workers’ Compensation Court of Appeals.
The motion is adopted along a voice vote.

Senator Marty moved that Confirmation of Minnesota Workers' Compensation Court of Appeals Judge
Kathryn H Carlson, be recommended for confirmation. - MOTION ADOPTED.

The meeting was adjourned at 1:03pm.

Jack@ischer, Legislative Assistant
